title: Bear cub waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='14' ry='14' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='21' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='26' r='9' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='26' r='9' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='26' r='5' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='26' r='5' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#4A2C1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='45' rx='1.2' ry='1' fill='#A0744A'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 50 Q50 54 54 50' stroke='#4A2C1A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#4A2C1A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#4A2C1A'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#D9C4A8'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#D9C4A8'/>
  <!-- left arm down -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='68' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(15 27 68)'/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='55' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(-35 74 55)'/>
  <!-- paw pads on waving hand -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- paw pads on feet -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='92' r='4' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='92' r='4' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- wave lines -->
  <path d='M85 36 Q89 33 93 36' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M84 44 Q89 42 93 45' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
